notes: Cheats disable trophies AND saving — never turn them on.
Keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter; there are 15 manual save slots.
There is no New Game+ and no mission replay, but free roam continues after the story and everything for 100% stays accessible.
The Irredeemable criminal profile cannot be undone — check what it needs before pushing your profile that way.
Lucia-only questline: Andy. Jason-only questlines: Tyrone and Bret. Hourglass quests expire but do not count for trophies.

stages.goal: Start right and protect the one trophy that can be missed.
steps: Turn the spoiler setting on if you want story trophies hidden until earned.
In Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, follow Lucia to the balcony at Jason's house and meditate — the first of 18 spots for Positive Mental Attitude. Do it before leaving Chapter 1.
Scan vehicles and study animals as you go; both feed the 100% checklist.
Keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter.
stages.title: Stage 0 — Before you start

stages.goal: Play the story through, chapter by chapter, and take every side mission you meet.
steps: Chapters 1 to 4, then the final mission — 6 chapter and finale trophies.
The named story missions: Gone Fishing, Breakfast Run, The Cartel Heist, Child's Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown, Operation Savage Glory.
Character finales as they open: Andy (Lucia-only), Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone (Jason-only).
Bret's hunts open for Jason — hunt a unique animal for Fair Game.
stages.title: Stage 1 — The story (60–80 hours)

stages.goal: Clear the collectibles and the big counters while free roam is open.
steps: WAiNK It at 100 locations; complete 3 Collectible Card sets (15 of 18 for 100%).
Discover 100 vehicles (200 of 277 for 100%); explore every region of Leonida.
Buy all 8 garage properties; register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
Meditate at the remaining spots — the last needs both characters after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
stages.title: Stage 2 — Collectibles and exploration

stages.goal: Grind the activities that feed 100% completion.
steps: 250 stunts (300 of 397 for 100%); gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges.
Win 20 different races; win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations.
Complete 50 Challenges (70 of 80 for 100%); try all 9 activity types once.
Beat Cal in a fishing challenge; finish an arcade game; bowl at Kolt & Associates.
Max Strength for both Jason and Lucia; perform 500 actions for your Criminal Profile.
stages.title: Stage 3 — Activities and challenges

stages.goal: Rob, escape and survive — the mayhem set.
steps: Rob 5 Bank Vaults after the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… (8 for 100%).
Rob an Armored Truck; rob one Illegal Operation for each of the 9 gangs.
Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner; lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner.
Steal a departing plane at VCIA; steal a Rhino tank; rob a jewelry store undetected.
Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills; spend $100,000 across all shops.
stages.title: Stage 4 — Heists and mayhem

stages.goal: Finish the 100% checklist, then the platinum.
steps: Open Progress > Stats and work the 100% checklist: 100 optional tasks, 39 Gang Operations, 22 Bank Jobs, 7 Payday Loan Jobs, 34 of 35 Smash 'N' Grabs, 50 of 91 Stick Ups, 8 Bank Vaults, fencing targets, treasure sets, card sets, WAiNK scans, Underwater Discoveries, magazines, meditations, Flamingos, playlists, styles, vehicles, weapons, animals, races, shooting golds, video games, pool, mini golf, basketball hoops, drone trials, stunts, challenges and Target Decks.
A Long Road pops at 100%; the platinum follows the moment the last trophy lands.
stages.title: Stage 5 — 100% cleanup and the platinum (~100 hours)

stages.goal: Five hidden trophies have no confirmed method yet — do not grind rumours.
steps: In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, Bad Luck I Guess and The Truth Is Out There: no confirmed method in PowerPyx, KeenGamer or gamemapa.
Ten Pin: reported as a melee drive-by knocking over bowling pins, but not yet confirmed.
Check the cited guides for updates; this guide will only list a method once a source confirms it.
stages.title: Still unconfirmed — do not chase rumours
